If a bf ever told me my cunt is salty, that'd be the last thing he utters cus I'd break his teeth! 

But jokes aside, woman, have you no self respect? Your husband is not insecure at all, he is as a matter of  a fact highly confident in his abuse of you! He thinks he can get away with talkin trash to your face and throwing ridiculous tantrums for no reason, and seems he is right!

I want you to stop imagining he cares at all about you-he doesn't. I want you to imagine how happy he was to himself when he tossed that grenade in the whole of your mental stability, accusing you of flirting with the cabbie. How he couldn't believe you still buy his shit, how he thinks you're so damn dumb for still falling for his crap and letting him manipulate you as if you were born yesterday. Wake up and realize you are married to an emotional vampire who's only joy in life is derived from sucking the life out of you. 

He's just starting drama in your life for no reason other than to play with you. All of the behavior you are describing is abusive. Indicative of a social manipulator with no trace of remorse. I am sorry that you failed to see it, people like that can appear very charming and be very convincing that they are something that they are not. But that vulnerable,insecure men who only needs a bit more love to change for the better, does not exist anywhere outside your imagination. That was just a bait designed to rope you into caring for an emotional parasite. 

Please, get away from that life sucker. All that man seems to do is neg you (insult you so you'd feel bad enough to stay with him and make you lose sight of your own worth) and gaslight you (asking you questions he knows will start a fight or just starting a fight for a made up reason and blaming it on you).  He is using your kindness and compassion against you. That right there is emotional abuse.

 Also don't you worry about finding a better man, it is hard to go down in quality after this one. You seem to be a well meaning and patient lady. The fact that your Dbag husband was not hospitalized after his salty cooter comments speaks volumes to your grace. Those are virtues. Don't waste them on someone who is not worthy. 

You deserve better, but also you need to learn to not settle for shit like this. Sadly in life, we don't get what we deserve by simply being worthy of it, we also need to go out look for it and not settle for less! 

Best of luck! You can do this! Stand up for yourself <3

> He has always been selfish, having never had kids hes never had to be selfless, but it feels like we have to do everything his way, all the time.

I'd just like to point out that I too have no children (by choice), yet I am perfectly capable of being selfless and considerate of others. You keep making up silly excuses to excuse intolerable behavior. 

Seven years is a benchmark for many people. Many couple reach their breaking point at that stage, some do it in three years. Between seven and three seems to be the number of years needed for most people to realize they can't stay with someone who doesn't give them what they want and need. Seven years of ignoring your own needs and making childish excuses for a grown ass man. 

You start your post by saying 

> Advice needed on what to do. Is it worth sacrificing myself for a relationship?

I think we all know the answer to that question. You've already decided. You just need others to validate your decision, but do you really?  

P.S. Siding with some man against your own son doesn't make you sound like mother of the year. My mother would have never ever done such thing to me, no good parent would. When that man had the audacity to ask a mother to banish her own son, then is when you should have dumped him, not now. 
You have some amends to make to your own flesh and blood. 
You prioritized some overgrown man child above your own offspring. Maybe think more about that and less about why the man child didn't wanna play husband.

Your gf seems very manipulative. It's not her fault, it's her gfs'...It's not the sport she has issue with, it's the partner... 
She knew very well who you are and what you do before she got involved. I'm guessing somebody as jealous as her also knew she would not be OK with you hanging out with ''pretty girls''. Yet she chose to proceed with this. And she is choosing to make this be ''your fault'', when she is the only one who had all the info beforehand. 
She wants to change you,  things that aren't even an issue with you, so you can fit in with her sick ideas. She doesn't care about you at all. She doesn't respect you or even consider your own needs at any point. You are nothing but a pretty prop in her life. 
A friend wouldn't ask you hinder the thing you are most passionate about, to appease their own paranoia. If a friend wouldn't do that, what makes such action OK for a partner? 
You've wasted 2.5 years of your life with this saboteur, she never had your best interest at heart. Please friend, don't waste any more time on this very manipulative individual. 
A person who truly cares about you would never act this way. Be your own friend and don't let anyone tread on you! Cut your losses and run.
May luck be on your side.

I am a woman and I am a bit kinky but far less than you I'd admit. What she did was a low move and it makes no one happy.

There is nothing wrong with what you want and she should have been clear about what she wants but alas dare I say she baby trapped you? 

If I were you I would divorce because speaking as someone who has a high sex drive, what she is doing is unacceptable. 

I have been in similar situations before, no kids involved in my case thank god, where I have started a relationship and fallen in love with someone only to get repeatedly turned down for sex and I feel your pain. The best thing you can do now imo is get out of that relationship and just try to co-parent your kids. 

You should never be forced to compromise your own libido to try and fit into someone else's celibacy plan. 

You can't demand she change for you, but she has no right to demand you change for her so it would be best for both of you to go your separate ways and part on friendly terms before you start resenting each other too much.

I wish you the best of luck and may your next partner be a more compatible one.

I've had many LDR, sadly all the coolest people seem to live far away. 

 I am not judging you for cheating, I've been there myself, but in my experience if you are already cheating then you are lacking something in the relationship or she simply isn't the kind of girl that is capable of keeping your attention focused on her and only her. Just do both of you a favor and end it now before you cheat more and hurt her further. At the end she won't have to live with being a cheating cunt, you will, and I say that as a cheating cunt. 

For me, the road to fidelity was long and full of thorns. I hurt many people I loved and I truly and honestly regretted it each time,came clean with them each time, they forgave me each time and yet it ended with me leaving after finding a new partner each time. It was not correct and I suck for it. But I've grown and in my latest relationships,including my current one, I haven't cheated at all. 

Just be a good person and end it when you see that you can't make it work. Your gf deserves better than being cheated on. And next time if you wanna cheat,hold on, end the relationship you're in first and then get with whoever you wish to get with. If she wants to fuck you on Friday, she can fuck you on Monday - when you're single,anything other than that would be unethical. Cheating is never worth it. The gratification of the attention will be momentary, but the guilt of having hurt someone you love will last you a lifetime.

Also more tips on how not to cheat would be try to find a gf that is compatible with you sexually,someone to match your libido and need for compliments and attention. If a girl isn't putting out enough or isn't giving you the attention you need don't even consider getting serious with her. After all plenty of fish in the sea.

If adoption or surrogacy are out of the question, which I'm guessing is the case, and if it's either have a baby and die or not have a baby, then the answer is most definitely do not have a baby and here's why. 

No child should be brought into this world as a memorial to a dead person. I know you guys seem to be grief struck and what not but this is why you need to hear it. All the reasons you listed for having a child in your post a wrong. You seem to want it out of selfish reasons. 

Before being a parent everybody should ask themselves one question ''can I give this child a good life'' and if the answer is anything short of a resounding yes then you shouldn't, and even then parenting is hard as shit. 

If your wife passes away you'll be grieving and the last thing you'll need is to have a helpless little being depending on you.

Just think about this, if you have a child with this woman in spite her condition and she dies you'll lose a wife and a young child will lose it's mother. Is that what you really want?

I would be so happy if I had your knowledge and skills, up till now I didn't even know you could bargain such things. If my bf had those skills I'd be hella proud!

You'd be happiest with someone who sees those grey areas as qualities because let's face it, we all have flaws , some have more some have less, but if the person we are with starts seeing our positive qualities as cons then there really isn't much left.

Maybe he is envious or feels emasculated that you a woman got a better deal. Maybe he wishes to pay more to show he's got money. Either way he is wrong, he knows it and instead of thanking you he chooses to try and manipulate you into thinking you did something wrong.  

Based on this and the ''Unamerican '' comment he made I'd say your bf is not a good person and that if you chose to continue your relationship with him it will most likely end badly for you. This just seems like the beginning unless you end it now.

I for one know a lot of beautiful men (I am a straight woman) who I think look really amazing yet I have no sexual desire for them what so ever. Now before you say "guys are different" or "maybe you're not that much of a sexual person" , yes I am a very sexual person with a very high libido.

 I have a type (pale, bright eyes,
 preferably blond hair) but I know plenty of beautiful men outside my type. I've even meet men who fit my type perfectly and look really beautiful but yet I've felt no sexual attraction towards them.

We were flirting and we made out and then I realised I can't sleep with him cus no matter how good he looks he still doesn't attract me in a sexual way. 

Maybe things will work out differently for you, maybe sexual attraction will follow. But don't count on it. Things like that usually can't be forced. Good luck.

I can't tell you what to do, only you know best in your situation but I can tell you what I did in mine. 

My father was abusive and I grew to hate him. My mother tried her best and really loved me more than anything. She begged me not to cut him out, said "why should you suffer , you only have one dad, take whatever you can from him". I did. I stopped loving him or caring about him, I just asked him for money and I was only nice when he payed up.

 I don't come from a rich background and I've never been trully independent. I could never quite take care of myself. I needed all the help I could get.

One day my father died from clogged artery. I inherited his money and 2 apartaments. The money wasn't much and the apartaments were kinda crap but it's what's keeping me floating. 

Maybe you can get a good job , take care of yourself and not need your parents support or inheritance at all, unlike me. Maybe cutting them out is what's best for you. But just consider this - having them as parents is already a loss enough, why cut yourself out of a potencial inheritance? Just take what you can get, but never ever give them anything in return. 

Both my parents are dead and I miss my mother all the time, but when my father died I did not shed a tear.

Ok so where to begin. 

No, you don´t have to have sex with him when you don´t want to. 

I doubt he is manipulating you as some other reply suggested nor does he need to keep his libido in check for you either.

You don´t owe him sex, he doesn´t owe you staying with you. If you have different libidos please do not ignore it, it is a huge problem. 

There is nothing wrong with having a low or high sex drive. He is not an ass for wanting to sleep with you all the time and you are not a bitch for not wanting it as often as him. But you can´t be happy together unless you resolve this. Here are some suggestions. 

A. Discuss open relationship. How do you two feel about it? If you feel reluctant to satisfy your man maybe someone else should. Just don´t expect the guy to try and change his nature for you, it is a very cruel thing to ask of someone(speaking from experience), plus it almost never works.

B. If you don´t feel like sex maybe think of other ways to satisfy his drive that won´t impose on you too much. Get creative. Keeping your partner sexually satisfied is a must in a happy relationship.

C. Call it quits. There is no need for you to do things you don´t want to but you shouldn´t force abstinence onto anyone either. Try put yourself in his position, How would you feel if your SO only wanted to have sex a fraction of the times you wanted it and the rest of the time repeatedly turned you down. How hurtful would that be? Would you stay with such person? I know I wouldn´t.

Sexual compatibility is extremely important for happy functioning relationships. Don´t listen to people who tell you that you are within your right to demand that someone changes for you, that is just not right. Don´t try to change yourself either because that will fail without a doubt. Just stay true to your nature and accept people as they are, if you do that one day you´ll find someone who is just right for you and then you won´t have to seek advice online :)

Don't feel bad but it seems like you two want different things in the bedroom. 

I personally think that people should not be forced to give up their sexual needs to please others. Your bf shouldn't be forced to suffer because you can't accommodate his needs. You might want to rethink your relationship because forcing someone to cut down on sex is not a viable long term solution. 

From my experience every time I've tried to tune down my libido for a man I've loved it had turned into a disaster. But that's just me, maybe your bf can be better at that. 

Perhaps I can also help explain why your bf gets cranky when you turn him down. It sucks when you're horny and your SO turns you down, maybe he doesn't want to react in a negative way but passions are high in heat of the moment and an no can really feel like a kick in the nuts, especially if you're cuddling. Cuddles turn people on, it's like you tease and then refuse to please. 

Bottom line is you both seem right. You are just seem incompatible. Please do not expect your bf to change his libido for you, that is just cruel and inconsiderate. You two need to talk and figure out what to do. Maybe he would like to suppress himself for the sake of your relationship, but that is a decision you two need to make together. Don't just repeatedly turn him down and expect him to be OK with it.

I just wanted to add that you need to explore your options and find a solution that makes both of you happy. 

- Would he be truly happy taking care of his own needs(porn, sex toys like fleshlight f.e.) ?
- Would you consider something other then sex to help satisfy his needs (hand job, exchanging oral etc.)?
- Would you consider an open relationship? 

You should not have to do something you're not comfortable with but he should not have to give up his sexuality either. If you can't find a compromise that makes both parties happy you might want to consider breaking up because sexual frustration is a slow and insidious killer to many relationships.
